title: 4th of July Picnic Reminder
summary: We hope everyone is looking forward to the 4th of July picnic in the North Clubhouse this Saturday starting at 4:00. We have had a great response with over 100 residents attending. There will be games for everyone to enjoy with some great prizes. The activities will include corn hole, washer toss, putting green, chair volleyball, candy jar guessing, patriotic trivia and patriotic word search.
